import re
from pathlib import Path
log = Path('/tmp/c6-soak.log')
if not log.is_file() or log.stat().st_size == 0:
    raise SystemExit('missing or empty /tmp/c6-soak.log')
text = log.read_bytes().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
local = len(re.findall(r'measurement local_i2c/', text))
sonoff = len(re.findall(r'measurement zigbee/zigbee:881a14fffeef6bd9/', text))
statuses = re.findall(r'link backend=uart1 peer=(\d+) tx=(\d+) rx=(\d+) invalid=(\d+) queue=(\d+)/(\d+) high=(\d+) drop=(\d+) short=(\d+)', text)
resources = re.findall(r'link last_tx_ms=(\d+) last_rx_ms=(\d+) min_heap=(\d+) tx_stack_hwm=(\d+) rx_stack_hwm=(\d+)', text)
fatal = re.findall(r'Guru Meditation|abort\(\)|panic|watchdog|ZIGBEE_DEVICE_LEAVE_RESET|APS.*security.*failed|security.*failed|dropped [1-9][0-9]* gateway events|dropped [1-9][0-9]* GatewayLink messages', text, re.I)
markers = re.findall(r'=== SOAK (chunk[1-4]) (START|END)', text)
if local < 100:
    raise SystemExit(f'too few local SCD4x measurements: {local}')
if sonoff < 3:
    raise SystemExit(f'too few SONOFF measurements: {sonoff}')
if len(statuses) < 20:
    raise SystemExit(f'too few link status samples: {len(statuses)}')
if fatal:
    raise SystemExit(f'fatal patterns found: {fatal[:5]}')
for s in statuses:
    peer, tx, rx, invalid, q, cap, high, drop, short = map(int, s)
    if peer != 0 or drop != 0 or short != 0 or q > cap:
        raise SystemExit(f'unhealthy link status: {s}')
if not resources:
    raise SystemExit('no link resource samples')
min_heaps = [int(r[2]) for r in resources]
tx_hwm = [int(r[3]) for r in resources]
rx_hwm = [int(r[4]) for r in resources]
if min(min_heaps) < 250000:
    raise SystemExit(f'min heap too low: {min(min_heaps)}')
if min(tx_hwm) < 1000 or min(rx_hwm) < 1000:
    raise SystemExit(f'stack high-water too low: tx={min(tx_hwm)} rx={min(rx_hwm)}')
expected_markers = {(f'chunk{i}', edge) for i in range(1,5) for edge in ('START','END')}
if set(markers) != expected_markers:
    raise SystemExit(f'incomplete soak markers: {markers}')
first = statuses[0]
last = statuses[-1]
first_res = resources[0]
last_res = resources[-1]
print('C6 UART SOAK PASS')
print(f'local_measurements={local} sonoff_measurements={sonoff} status_samples={len(statuses)}')
print(f'first_link_status peer={first[0]} tx={first[1]} rx={first[2]} invalid={first[3]} queue={first[4]}/{first[5]} high={first[6]} drop={first[7]} short={first[8]}')
print(f'last_link_status peer={last[0]} tx={last[1]} rx={last[2]} invalid={last[3]} queue={last[4]}/{last[5]} high={last[6]} drop={last[7]} short={last[8]}')
print(f'first_resources min_heap={first_res[2]} tx_stack_hwm={first_res[3]} rx_stack_hwm={first_res[4]}')
print(f'last_resources min_heap={last_res[2]} tx_stack_hwm={last_res[3]} rx_stack_hwm={last_res[4]}')
print(f'min_heap={min(min_heaps)} tx_stack_hwm_min={min(tx_hwm)} rx_stack_hwm_min={min(rx_hwm)}')
